conclusions: Current full Setup cannot meet300s at20Mbps: payload transfer alone is416.026s.
Allowing missing V1 packs is neither a safe change nor sufficient: only40 explicitly identified startup/login resources already touch26packs860.7MB.
Full install and progressive install are different products. No progressive mode or300s acceptance is implemented or approved by this audit.

Minimum progressive design is a signed versioned required-scope contract, dependency-local repacking, verified PartialStore, persistent transport jobs, and actual map readiness gates. V1 strict full-store behavior remains unchanged.
Immediate independent work is provenance/phase tracing and measured release-profile/lossless sizing; neither implies a new product-mode decision.

losslessTransportProposal.criticalLimit: Existing1.04GB Inno Setup is already compressed. Do not subtract133.94MB from Setup or claim the experiment speeds that existing package. Savings apply to separately downloaded identity Game/catalog objects in a new signed transport path.
losslessTransportProposal.minimalContract: Optional CMS-signed per-generation transport sidecar binds generation digest, original path/raw size/raw SHA, codec=gzip-single-v1, encoded size/SHA and immutable encoded key. Existing GEN raw object identity remains authoritative; absent sidecar uses unchanged identity transport. Old clients ignore the sidecar.
decoderGates: Accept-Encoding: identity even for the .gz object; Range offsets refer to encoded bytes
Verify exact encoded length/SHA before decoding
Bound decoded output by signed raw size, verify exact raw SHA, reject trailing/extra members and decode errors
Decode into private scratch, fsync and promote_new only after complete verification
Retain original signed PE bytes and metadata; no post-attestation mutation, executable packing or TLS/CMS bypass

two compiled HTTPS origins, no redirects/userinfo/query/fragment, encoded path containment; source adapter seam

logical path/case/index/extent bounds, real Windows directory/file leases, full object SHA and each resource SHA; previous content locators/pack IDs reused unchanged
existing optional authenticated previous catalog input; next builds only new content

actualGaps: V1 read_generation requires catalog pack set exactly equal manifest packs; verify_selection/seed adoption/accept and Game PackStore::open require every pack.
GenerationManifest has no signed mandatory/optional scope semantics; changing open to skip missing files would weaken the contract.

Current32MiB fresh content-hash grouping disperses small boot dependencies across huge unrelated packs; previous-aware incremental reuse already exists but cannot repair first-generation boot locality.
Current .part files preserve payload bytes, but no durable target/scope/retry/mirror job ledger exists.
Current downloader has no ETag/If-Range contract or multi-mirror planning/health persistence; it retries only two compiled origins and a stream failure needs a later retry.
Current check_update caller holds InstallLock/GameLease across download and activation; background immutable staging needs separation from the short selector commit.
Game existing Option/poison paths and login-only Ready cannot prove actual operational map completeness; use the independent Game audit for required changes.

Current resource-pack bounds are300000 resources,256 packs,64MiB per pack,4GiB total and128MiB catalog; target pack size32MiB. Repeated incremental additions/fragmentation must not silently exceed those bounds. Any V2 limit change needs explicit bounded validation; V1 limits stay unchanged.

minimalProgressiveProposal.status: OPTION ONLY — product choice pending; no implementation in this audit
minimalProgressiveProposal.firstVersionScope: One full signed catalog retained, explicit boot + chosen initial-map + common-appearance dependency closures. Catalog sharding/per-resource range CAS are later options.
signedV2Fields: scope IDs and exact logical dependency/required pack sets
boot scope plus selected-map closure rule
minimalProgressiveProposal.store: Keep V1 PackStore::open strict. Add a separate verified subset/PartialStore path that authenticates full catalog, checks exact required-set membership, opens/hashes every required local pack/index, keeps leases, and preserves resource SHA checks. MissingLocal(required) is Pending/Blocked, not Option None or successful mount.
minimalProgressiveProposal.repacking: Build the initial V2 boot/domain layout offline from exact existing255063 logical size/SHA pairs; group by boot/shared/map/library affinity with bounded ~8MiB packs. Reuse BuildOptions and previous locators on subsequent releases. No changed art/economy or lossy asset removal. Verify actual boot/world closure size before selecting the400MB budget.
minimalProgressiveProposal.sceneGate: Obtain normal authenticated target-map info before StartGame where possible; otherwise MapChange enters explicit loading with input/combat presentation blocked until signed closure and actual initial AOI resources are ready. Server supplies no arbitrary resource URL. Preserve authoritative position, liveness and reconnect semantics; do not use empty maps/placeholder actors to fake the target.
minimalProgressiveProposal.firstInstaller: Separate opt-in streaming/bootstrap mode; preserve full offline repair package. New explicit bootstrap-download action may fetch content; do not redefine strict --play-installed into a network operation. Do not fabricate legacy game metadata/history to admit a fresh V2 install.
minimalProgressiveProposal.readiness: Keep authenticated Ready/PID/nonce plus10s liveness. V2 health explicitly means its signed required install set, not all optional assets. Materialization completeness is separate. A300s claim additionally requires rendered actual map, required initial AOI and a normal authoritative action ACK; login screenshot alone is insufficient.

engineCompatibilityBlocker.currentConstraint: Old Game SDK Engine::parse rejects engine.version > ENGINE_VERSION2; globally switching active engine to3 can break old healthy play and rollback.
engineCompatibilityBlocker.minimalRecommendedPath: Retain the compatible Engine2 metadata envelope/numeric version initially. First deliver a signed engine-only update supporting both V1 and V2; V2 generation has a new schema and explicit required engine code/source SHA binding. Old engines reject unknown V2 and retain verified V1. Retained old Game SDKs still see compatible Engine2 metadata. Require real old15/16/19 V1 launch and rollback tests with the new engine.
engineCompatibilityBlocker.ifNumeric3Required: Implement a separately signed V2 engine slot/selection while keeping the old active.txt/Engine2 view for old SDKs, or migrate retained SDKs first. Prove both views and leases; do not merely relax new parse and assume old binaries changed.
engineCompatibilityBlocker.releaseBlockedUntil: Known old Game + new controller + failed V2 health rollback works; no all-clients/global pointer bump before that evidence.

persistentDownloadAndMirrorContract.storage: One bounded create-only plan + atomic progress checkpoint per authenticated generation/scope job; existing SHA-named .part/CAS object layout remains. A job receipt is never asset authority.
persistedFields: generation manifest digest and signed source-policy digest
object key, raw/encoded SHA+size and codec
selected origin ID and per-origin strong ETag when provided
verified/promoted object status, revalidated from files after restart
persistentDownloadAndMirrorContract.recovery: Recover actual part length; treat all partial bytes as untrusted. Reauthenticate target/floors, rehash full final object, fsync and create-only promote. Interrupted/cancelled jobs retain safely bounded scratch; no selector/Healthy write until complete required-set verification.
persistentDownloadAndMirrorContract.mirrors: Compiled or separately signed HTTPS origin/prefix allowlist only, immutable identical object keys, TLS verification and redirects disabled. No user-supplied URL, credentials, query alias, captcha/JS challenge or unsigned fallback. Choose using small useful object ranges and measured progress; count probe/retry bodies inside the budget. Preserve same discovery JSON/signature pair identity and downgrade floors.
persistentDownloadAndMirrorContract.http: Retain exact206 Content-Range/total validation,200 restart rather than append,416 checked restart,identity encoding and duplicate-header/body bounds. Per-origin strong ETag may support If-Range; do not compare opaque ETags across providers. Final signed SHA remains mandatory.
persistentDownloadAndMirrorContract.boundedScheduling: Reuse max4 workers, boot/current-scope priority; defer optional work until required readiness. Bound each origin retry/backoff and total deadline; switching mirror does not reset D0. No unlimited concurrency or integrity-error downgrade fallback.
persistentDownloadAndMirrorContract.currentMirrorLimitation: Two pinned origins are not a qualified global throughput service. Existing measured failed path is below baseline; source mirrors and payload locality both need evidence.

atomicIncrementalUpdate.stage: Plan only missing hashes, reuse prior catalog locators and immutable local objects. Download/verify new objects while the old generation remains selected; no in-place pack/EXE overwrite.
atomicIncrementalUpdate.commit: After all mandatory code/catalog/scope objects are durable, take short InstallLock + exclusive GameLease, require normal old Game save/close, recheck target/floors/previous healthy identity, then atomically commit pending selector and attempt nonce.
atomicIncrementalUpdate.acceptOrRollback: Launch selected generation; require the same strong Ready/liveness. On failure preserve quarantine/unknown recovery semantics and restore only a fully verified retained previous generation. A fresh install has no invented healthy rollback.
atomicIncrementalUpdate.activeStreaming: A separate immutable object-fetch worker can add packs for the current signed generation without rewriting its selector; game mounts only fully verified scope sets and never consumes .part files.
atomicIncrementalUpdate.gc: No early deletion to make space. Pin active, previous healthy, in-flight jobs/scopes and real game leases; delete only unreferenced objects under a separately audited GC transaction after health. Disk preflight includes encoded scratch, decoded scratch/new objects and preserved rollback footprint. Track pack-count/physical-byte fragmentation; a compaction that changes mandatory pack hashes must still satisfy the same400MB/update deadline budget, not be hidden as free background work.
atomicIncrementalUpdate.timeLimit: 300s updates require bounded mandatory delta. Unlimited new content cannot fit a finite20Mbps budget; reject an oversized300s qualification plan rather than label a full repair or hidden background download as a passed update.
